panels.description: All catalog routes ranked by projected $/M (blended cost of the route's 7-day token mix at current asks; cached input billed at 10%; no-traffic routes use a 0.75/0.25 in/out mix). Tier: green = in use (>=100 billed reqs/7d), yellow = light, gray = catalog/probe-only. Cache green = high, TTFT green = fast.

targets.rawSql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT model, sum(prompt_tokens)::float AS tin, sum(completion_tokens)::float AS tout,
         sum(cached_tokens)::float/NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens),0) AS hr
  FROM usage_logs WHERE is_probe = false AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1
), u24 AS (
  SELECT model, count(*) AS req FROM usage_logs
  WHERE is_probe = false AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1
), base AS (
  SELECT rm.route, rm.ask_in, rm.ask_out, rm.iq, rm.supports_cache,
    COALESCE(agg.tin,0) AS tin, COALESCE(agg.tout,0) AS tout, COALESCE(agg.hr,0) AS hr,
    COALESCE(u24.req,0) AS req24,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(u24.req,0) >= 100 THEN 'in use'
         WHEN COALESCE(u24.req,0) > 0 THEN 'probed'
         ELSE 'catalog' END AS tier
  FROM route_metrics rm
  LEFT JOIN agg ON agg.model = rm.route
  LEFT JOIN u24 ON u24.model = rm.route
  WHERE rm.iq IS NOT NULL AND rm.ask_in > 0
), px AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    CASE WHEN tin+tout > 0
      THEN ( tin*((1-hr)*ask_in + hr*0.1*ask_in) + tout*ask_out ) / (tin+tout)
      ELSE 0.75*ask_in + 0.25*ask_out END AS projected
  FROM base
  WHERE true
)
SELECT px.route AS "Route",
  round(px.projected::numeric,4) AS "Projected $/M",
  round(px.iq / NULLIF(px.projected,0)) AS "IQ per $",
  round(px.ask_in::numeric,4) AS "Ask in $/M",
  round(px.ask_out::numeric,4) AS "Ask out $/M",
  round(px.iq) AS "AA IQ",
  CASE px.tier WHEN 'in use' THEN 2 WHEN 'probed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Tier",
  u.reqs AS "Reqs (7d)",
  u.tok AS "Tokens (7d)",
  u.cache_pct AS "Cache %",
  u.ttft AS "TTFT ms",
  u.tps AS "TPS",
  u.cost AS "Cost $",
  u.realized AS "Realized $/M"
FROM px
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT model,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe) AS reqs,
    sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe) AS tok,
    round(100.0*sum(cached_tokens) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe)/NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe),0),1) AS cache_pct,
    round(avg(ttft_ms) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe)) AS ttft,
    round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (completion_tokens / ((duration_ms - ttft_ms)/1000.0))) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe AND duration_ms > ttft_ms + 50 AND ttft_ms > 0 AND completion_tokens > 0 AND (completion_tokens / ((duration_ms - ttft_ms)/1000.0)) <= 500)::numeric, 1) AS tps,
    round(sum(cost_usdc) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe)::numeric,4) AS cost,
    round((sum(cost_usdc) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe)/NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe),0)*1e6)::numeric,4) AS realized
  FROM usage_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1
) u ON u.model = px.route
ORDER BY px.projected ASC NULLS LAST

panels.description: Cheapest in-use route by the gated $/M basis. Price is the board's money-basis owner, published per route, gated: realized $/M while the backtest gate is closed, projected once it passes. The value names the basis in use.

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT pass FROM projection_gate WHERE id = 'projection_gate'), false) AS use_proj
), u24 AS (
  SELECT model, count(*) AS req FROM usage_logs
  WHERE is_probe = false AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1
), u30 AS (
  SELECT model, sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens)::float AS tok30,
         sum(cost_usdc)::float AS cost30
  FROM usage_logs WHERE is_probe = false AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1
), base AS (
  SELECT rm.route, rm.iq,
    COALESCE(b.realized, CASE WHEN COALESCE(u30.tok30,0) > 0
      THEN round((u30.cost30/u30.tok30*1e6)::numeric, 4) END) AS realized,
    CASE WHEN g.use_proj THEN b.projected END AS projected
  FROM route_metrics rm
  CROSS JOIN g
  LEFT JOIN route_basis b ON b.route = rm.route
  LEFT JOIN u30 ON u30.model = rm.route
  LEFT JOIN u24 ON u24.model = rm.route
  WHERE rm.iq IS NOT NULL AND rm.ask_in > 0 AND COALESCE(u24.req,0) >= 100
), ranked AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    COALESCE(projected, realized) AS basis_per_m,
    CASE WHEN projected IS NOT NULL THEN 'projected' ELSE 'realized' END AS basis
  FROM base
  WHERE COALESCE(projected, realized) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ranked.route || ' · ' || ranked.basis AS "Route"
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ranked.basis_per_m ASC, ranked.iq/NULLIF(ranked.basis_per_m,0) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

panels.description: How well the route predictor ranks and levels, at three cadences (issue #30). ORDERING (the verdict) = the crown backtest's regret share: of the transitions where the board would have crowned a route, what share realized within GATE_TOL (15%) of the cheapest. LEVEL (the diagnostic) = realized / projected ratio. The VALUE leg is the North Star metric (probe/value.py) scored on realized outcomes. DAILY is measured — each snapshot's own as-of IQ stamp, backfilled from the git-tracked data/intelligence.json history (D3): real historical values, never interpolated. The HOURLY legs read 'n/a' by design, NOT as a failure: the hourly series is rebuilt from usage_logs and carries no D3 iq stamp, and IQ's own resolution is a day, so there is no as-of IQ to read at an hourly boundary. The daily leg is the leg that can be scored.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  cadence AS "Cadence",
  transitions AS "Transitions",
  cost_n AS "Cost n",
  cost_land AS "Cost land",
  cost_share AS "Cost share",
  CASE WHEN cost_pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS "Cost verdict",
  value_n AS "Value n",
  value_land AS "Value land",
  value_share AS "Value share",
  CASE WHEN value_status = 'measured'
       THEN CASE WHEN value_pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END
       ELSE 'n/a - ' || COALESCE(value_limit, 'unresolved')
  END AS "Value verdict",
  level_n AS "Level n",
  level_median AS "Level median",
  level_within_50pct AS "Level within 50pct",
  level_within_2x AS "Level within 2x",
  computed_at AS "Computed"
FROM predictor_scoreboard
ORDER BY CASE cadence
  WHEN 'daily' THEN 0 WHEN 'hourly_cumulative' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

panels.title: Predictor scoreboard — ordering accuracy (verdict) + level ratio (diagnostic)

panels.description: The projection gate, BOTH legs (issue #35, item 2 of the 2026-09-12 owner decision set). The gate's question is unchanged: of the transitions where the board would have crowned a route (lowest projected $/M), what share realized within GATE_TOL (15%) of the cheapest realized route. What item 2 moved is the METRIC the regret ratio is taken on. COST takes it on realized $/M; VALUE takes it on the North Star metric (probe/value.py), on both sides of the ratio, never mixed. The same GATE_TOL / GATE_SHARE / GATE_MIN_N apply to both - a pass/fail constant is owner property and is never re-tuned to make a leg pass. IMPORTANT: the 'Cost verdict' column is what the panels' projected-basis switch reads (projection_gate.pass). The Value leg is PUBLISHED alongside it, not substituted for it; which leg the gate ships on is an owner decision, and until it is taken the disagreement is shown here rather than resolved silently. A 'n/a - unresolved' Value verdict is a RESOLUTION limit of the input (no as-of IQ stamp on the snapshot), never evidence that Value failed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS "Cost verdict",
  n AS "Cost n",
  land AS "Cost land",
  share AS "Cost share",
  CASE WHEN value_status = 'measured'
       THEN CASE WHEN value_pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END
       ELSE 'n/a - ' || COALESCE(value_status, 'unresolved')
  END AS "Value verdict",
  value_n AS "Value n",
  value_land AS "Value land",
  value_share AS "Value share",
  value_status AS "Value status",
  computed_at AS "Computed"
FROM projection_gate
WHERE id = 'projection_gate'

panels.title: Projection gate — both legs (cost verdict + Value measurement)
